function add(a, b) {
  return a + b;
}

function classify(n) {
  if (n < 0) {
    return "negative";
  } else if (n === 0) {
    return "zero";
  } else {
    return "positive";
  }
}

const double = (x) => {
  if (x > 0 && x < 100) {
    return x * 2;
  }
  return x;
};

class Counter {
  constructor(start) {
    this.value = start;
  }

  increment(step) {
    if (step) {
      this.value += step;
    } else {
      this.value += 1;
    }
    return this.value;
  }
}

function pick(flag, a, b) {
  return flag ? a : b;
}

module.exports = { add, classify, double, Counter, pick };
